title: Re-orthonormalize a Drifting Rotation
hints: The closest orthogonal matrix in Frobenius norm comes from the SVD M = U Σ Vᵀ: Q = U Vᵀ.
U Vᵀ can have det = −1 (a reflection). Then flip the sign of the last column of U (the one paired with the smallest singular value): R = U diag(1, 1, det(U Vᵀ)) Vᵀ.
Eigen: `Eigen::JacobiSVD<Eigen::Matrix3d> svd(M, Eigen::ComputeFullU | Eigen::ComputeFullV);` Singular values are sorted in decreasing order.
